tests.name: Every inventory fixture exists in static card and table representations
Each rendered card and table row has an original HTTPS source
Fixture ID search is functional and precise
Empty search has a readable no-results state
Competition filter counts reconcile to dataset
Elapsed listings are separately filterable and have blank prematch values
Pagination reaches additional fixtures without losing source links
A direct fixture fragment reveals a fixture on a later page
Mobile table switches correctly and scrolls locally, not the entire page
Unconfirmed probabilities render as dashes, never neutral fills
Evidence expands to the original sources and review notes
Expired snapshot hides probabilities and picks in the browser
No-JavaScript view retains all inventory rows and source evidence
